title: Alex New TP
script:
-- =============================================
--   SAVE TP & TP TO SAVE (Draggable GUI)
--   Para Delta Executor
-- =============================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local savedPosition = nil

-- Crear GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SaveTP_Draggable"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 160)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -120, 0.3, 0)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Bordes redondeados
local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
UICorner.Parent = Frame

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
Title.Text = "💾 Save TP System"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 15
Title.Parent = Frame

local TitleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TitleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
TitleCorner.Parent = Title

local SaveButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
SaveButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 45)
SaveButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.32, 0)
SaveButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 80)
SaveButton.Text = "💾 GUARDAR POSICIÓN"
SaveButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SaveButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
SaveButton.TextSize = 14
SaveButton.Parent = Frame

local TPButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
TPButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 45)
TPButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.65, 0)
TPButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
TPButton.Text = "🚀 TELEPORT A SAVE"
TPButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TPButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
TPButton.TextSize = 14
TPButton.Parent = Frame

-- Hacer la GUI arrastrable
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPos

local function updateInput(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    Frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Frame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Title.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then
        updateInput(input)
    end
end)

-- Funciones
local function SavePosition()
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        savedPosition = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "✅ Guardado",
            Text = "Posición guardada correctamente",
            Duration = 3
        })
    end
end

local function TeleportToSave()
    if savedPosition and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local root = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {CFrame = savedPosition}):Play()
        
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "✅ Teleport",
            Text = "Teletransportado correctamente",
            Duration = 3
        })
    else
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "⚠️ Error",
            Text = "No hay posición guardada",
            Duration = 4
        })
    end
end

-- Conexiones
SaveButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(SavePosition)
TPButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(TeleportToSave)

-- Atajos de teclado
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F5 then
        SavePosition()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F6 then
        TeleportToSave()
    end
end)

print("✅ Save TP Draggable cargado | Arrastra desde el título | F5 = Save | F6 = TP")
